name: Exeaon Research Reproduction Benchmark (starter)
note: A fixed set of reproduction TASKS (reproduce each `target` from its `paper`, record it with score_reproduction(name=<task id>, claimed=<your value>, reference=<task reference>); benchmark_report aggregates matched/total). Populate from EXISTING open reproduction benchmarks — their format is target->number, identical to ours: CORE-Bench (270 tasks/90 papers, github.com/siegelz/core-bench + HF siegelz/core-bench, arXiv:2409.11363), PaperBench (arXiv:2504.01848), REPRO-Bench, SciReplicate-Bench. IMPORTANT: CORE-Bench's TEST answers are encrypted on purpose (anti-leakage) — do NOT commit protected answers into this file; keep a downloaded dataset LOCAL and convert (target=question, reference=answer). Every `reference` MUST be a number a source actually states (cite it in `provenance`) or one Exeaon independently measured. Never invent a reference.

tasks.provenance: CORE-Bench README answer-schema example (report.json), arXiv:2409.11363 / github.com/siegelz/core-bench.

tasks.target: Extra lossless (rANS/entropy) compression gain on REAL group-128 AWQ int4 LLM weights
tasks.hint: Quantize a real model to per-group(128) zero-point int4 (or load an official AWQ checkpoint); measure the code histogram entropy H per tensor, parameter-weighted; gain = 4 / H (include scale/zero metadata for the end-to-end figure).
tasks.provenance: Measured in Exeaon's own reproduction run (2026-09-09) on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-AWQ; brackets EntroLLM's ~1.05x and 2606.15789's 1.1-1.3x band. Replace with a paper-stated figure if reproducing a specific paper.
